summary: A feeling that has been difficult to process can soften enough for you to finally hear what it has been trying to tell you all along.
body: A feeling that has been difficult to process can soften enough for you to finally hear what it has been trying to tell you all along. When the Moon trines Neptune, sensitivity and intuition support each other, making it easier to recognize the emotional truth underneath the noise without forcing it into an immediate, rigid decision. Music, rest, creativity, solitude, or simply stepping away from everyone else's input will bring more clarity than another hour spent trying to reason your way through the fog. Not every answer arrives just because you push harder for it.
